definitions.explanation: A decorative design, illustration, or pattern on a surface. Used for designs on fabric, stamps, currency, cards, pottery, and similar items.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{切手|きって}の{図柄|ずがら}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The design for the new stamps was announced.

examples.japanese: この{着物|きもの}は{図柄|ずがら}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This kimono has a beautiful pattern.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}しい{紙幣|しへい}の{図柄|ずがら}には{歴史上|れきしじょう}の{人物|じんぶつ}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: The designs on the new banknotes depict historical figures.

notes:
Compound of {図|ず} (drawing, diagram) + {柄|がら} (pattern, design). Refers specifically to a pictorial or decorative design printed or drawn on a surface.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切手|きって}の{図柄|ずがら}: stamp design
- {紙幣|しへい}の{図柄|ずがら}: banknote design
- {着物|きもの}の{図柄|ずがら}: kimono pattern
- {図柄|ずがら}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose a design
- {図柄|ずがら}が{入|はい}った: with a design on it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {模様|もよう}: pattern — broader, includes abstract repeating patterns
- {柄|がら}: pattern — the base element, often for fabric patterns
- デザイン: design — loanword, broader and more modern
- {絵柄|えがら}: picture/illustration design — very similar, slightly more emphasis on pictorial art
